report.limits: Counts apply only to selected manifest-listed common/1 recipe assets. SQL joins preserve asserted/candidate statuses; missing edges are not synthesized. No live app or nutritional/culinary qualification claimed.

automaticPlanningEligibleFalseAssertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE property=? AND boolean_value=0

automaticPlanningEligibleTrueAssertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE property=? AND boolean_value=1

ingredientIdentityCandidates.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relations WHERE predicate=? AND status='candidate'

ingredientMentions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM resources WHERE type=?

ingredientQuantityJoins.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relations e JOIN resources r ON r.id=e.subject JOIN resources i ON i.id=e.object JOIN facts q ON q.subject=i.id WHERE e.predicate=? AND r.type=? AND i.type=? AND q.property=? AND q.value_kind='quantity' AND e.scope=r.scope AND r.scope=i.scope AND i.scope=q.scope AND e.status NOT IN ('superseded','conflicting','needs-transcription','unknown') AND q.status NOT IN ('superseded','conflicting','needs-transcription')

ingredientUnknownQuantities.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE property=? AND value_kind='quantity' AND numeric_value IS NULL

ingredientZeroQuantities.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE property=? AND value_kind='quantity' AND numeric_value=0

knownSourceYieldAssertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE property=? AND value_kind='quantity' AND numeric_value>0

recipeIngredientMentionsResolved.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relations e JOIN resources r ON r.id=e.subject JOIN resources i ON i.id=e.object WHERE e.predicate=? AND r.type=? AND i.type=? AND r.scope=i.scope AND e.scope=r.scope AND e.status NOT IN ('superseded','conflicting','needs-transcription','unknown')

recipeNutrientObservationEdges.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relations e JOIN resources s ON s.id=e.subject WHERE e.predicate=? AND s.type=?

recipeVariants.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM resources WHERE type=?

reviewedExactIngredientIdentityLinks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relations e JOIN resources s ON s.id=e.subject WHERE e.predicate=? AND e.status IN ('reviewed','verified') AND s.type=?

sourceRecipeStepJoins.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relations e JOIN resources r ON r.id=e.subject JOIN resources s ON s.id=e.object WHERE e.predicate=? AND r.type=? AND s.type=? AND e.scope=r.scope AND r.scope=s.scope AND e.status NOT IN ('superseded','conflicting','needs-transcription','unknown')

stepIngredientJoins.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relations e JOIN resources s ON s.id=e.subject JOIN resources i ON i.id=e.object WHERE e.predicate=? AND s.type=? AND i.type=? AND e.scope=s.scope AND s.scope=i.scope AND e.status NOT IN ('superseded','conflicting','needs-transcription','unknown')
